primary_estimand: Not an exercise study. Paper compares low-biofilm-producing (LBP: 29T, 49B) vs biofilm-producing (BP: 1T, 35B) C. parapsilosis isolates; GSE344550 is human macrophage RNA-seq after infection with these isolates (control, 3 h, 24 h): BP vs LBP-infected macrophages at 3 and 24 h.
planned_contrasts: macrophage response BP-infected vs LBP-infected at 3 h (S4.13.p1)
macrophage response BP-infected vs LBP-infected at 24 h (S4.13.p1)
paper_method: edgeR on raw counts, ~0 + group:time, |log2FC| > 1 (no stated FDR); fgsea on log2FC ranks
exercise_content: none: no exercise, physical activity, or training factor anywhere in the paper (fungal pathogen evolution / immune evasion)
paper_results: No DEG counts reported in text (S6-S9 Tables not in the paper text).
